name: Austral-Glen

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by ancient meteor crater and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Vacuous air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in salvageable alloys and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
